text:
maria: FYI — large number of failed GPU node onboards in ap-south-1 starting ~03:05 UTC. Saw KMS decrypt AccessDenied and a concurrent spike in central-audit PUTs. Billing alarm fired.

 taylor: any diffs from last deploy? who rolled what yesterday?

 maria: infra pushed a keystore policy tightening at 22:40 UTC yesterday to add aws:SourceVpc and aws:SourceVpce conditions. Change ticket INFRA-1742.

 sasha: that should be fine normally, is the control-plane using privatelink endpoints per region?

 jordi: control-plane talks to regional keystore via cross-account privatelink endpoints. Onboarding path spins up ephemeral STS creds in control plane, then calls keystore:Decrypt from the region endpoint. The new condition is evaluating to false for ap-south because our privatelink endpoint ID differs (we used a recently rotated endpoint).

 maria: stack trace from a failed node: 
```
Error: KMS AccessDenied
  at Keystore.decrypt (/srv/onboard/keystore_client.js:87:21)
  with request context: { region: "ap-south-1", sourceVpce: "vpce-aaaa1111" }
  KMSResponse: AccessDeniedException: Condition check failed: aws:SourceVpc
```

 taylor: okay so two things: nodes can't decrypt (blocks GPU join) and audit pipeline is writing debug-level failure logs to the long-term bucket. Why are debug events going to central?

 sasha: config drift: the audit-forwarder was flipped to route debug/ to redwood-audit-central by mistake in release 2026.02. The intended target was redwood-audit-staging. I have the diff.

 jordi: consequence: keystore failures are high-frequency so the central bucket is getting hammered with tiny objects, causing cost + request rate alarms. Also S3 request throttling risks backpressure on the log pipeline.

 ops-bot: Incident IR-2026-089 created. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/ops/keystore-onboard. Paging oncall.

 taylor: mitigation plan now: 1) whitelist current control-plane VPCE id in keystore policy for ap-south 2) change audit-forwarder to send debug/ to staging and pause debug-level streams to central 3) apply a short lifecycle to central debug prefix to expire objects in 5d 4) requeue failed nodes with extended STS expiry.

 maria: I've pushed a targeted policy patch to the keystore role allowing Decrypt for arn:aws:ec2:ap-south-1::vpce/vpce-aaaa1111 and restricted to the control-plane principal. Patch applied as emergency-cherry.

 sasha: I reverted the audit-forwarder route and temporarily disabled debug-level producers. Also added a temporary throttle on audit-shipping from 2k->250 qps.

 jordi: requeued onboarding; 7/9 nodes now finished join. Two failed due to expired STS sessions; increasing STS duration for replay to 12h and retrying.

 maria: run this CLI to reduce current bucket cost footprint (I executed):
```
aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket redwood-audit-central --lifecycle-configuration '{"Rules":[{"ID":"expire-debug-5d","Prefix":"debug/","Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":5}}]}'
```

 taylor: good. post-mitigation tasks: create a canary that validates keystore Decrypt across all region VPCE ids on deploy, add policy automation to append new VPCE ids for control-plane endpoints during region bootstrap, and add an audit-forwarder integration test.

 sasha: I'll own the audit-forwarder test and raising a PR to revert the accidental route change from the release diff. EST 1d.

 jordi: I'll own the VPCE whitelist automation (INFRA-1790) EST 2d. Will also add a guard in the infra-sweep job to block keystore policy changes without a canary flag.

 ops-bot: IR-2026-089 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Attachments: node list, cost-snapshot, policy-diff.

 ci-bot: Deploy rollback flagged: keystore-policy-sweep-2026-02. Manual approval required.

 taylor: decision: do not rollback the VPC restriction. Keep the tightened policy. Apply targeted allow for the specific control-plane VPCE and automate future adds. Re-enable debug streaming after canary completes.

 maria: I'll prepare the post-incident notes and cost impact estimate. tagging jordi + sasha as postmortem leads. If any more onboards fail, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
